title: Boundless Dataset Expansion Engine — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Generates additional records where generation is appropriate while distinguishing synthetic from sourced facts. Where generation is legitimate, the engine extends datasets with synthetic records — every one labeled synthetic, never mixed with sourced facts. Framing: "God Mode" here means an ambitious engineering target — maximum useful capability, broad interoperability, deep automation, and rigorous verification — NOT unlimited intelligence or guaranteed success.
